messages:
maya: Taking morning watch — quick summary so the next shift has context. 06:14 UTC we saw a 503 spike for embeddings/us-east. Pager fired, autoscaler kicked, noisy batch job identified and throttled. Customer impact: ~15% requests 503 for ~7m, mostly proxied through APAC edge. I'm primary handoff lead for next 30m; @sam is primary now, @liam secondary for next 3h. Runbooks linked below.

sam: I'm on it. Autoscaler scaled pool embeddings-primary 6->14 nodes, eviction pressure on KV cache was root cause (noisy tenant). Enabled soft-eviction and paused the heavy job. Error rate down to ~0.3%. APAC edge still showing occasional 503s via rproxy logs.

liam: On mobile, saw the pager. I can cover for the next hour. Note: secondary pool wasn't warm — no spare capacity for instant failover. If it recurs we should consider temp dedicated capacity.

maya: Flagging coverage gap explicitly: backup pool not warmed. Action items: @sam add the `manual-warm` tag to the secondary pool per runbook so we can failover quickly next time. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ops/eviction-503 (see "warm standby" section).

sam: Doing that now. CLI I ran: `rctl pools tag --pool embeddings-secondary --tag manual-warm=true`

opsbot: Tag applied: `embeddings-secondary` now has `manual-warm=true` (applied by sam at 06:48 UTC)

pagerbot: INCIDENT 2026-06-03-173: 06:14 UTC - 503-surge-embeddings-us-east - status: RESOLVED -> stable at 06:21 UTC. Alerts suppressed for 10m while we observe.

maya: Current status = stable. Next steps: @sam run a short loadtest against secondary to validate failover path; @liam monitor dashboards 06:50-09:00. I'll write a short postmortem and attach eval diffs for quality to ensure the noisy job change didn't regress outputs.

sam: Loadtest completed — `kubectl exec -n infra -c canary -- /bin/loadtest --target embeddings-secondary --rps 100` — no 503s observed, p95 latency within baseline. Putting handover note in incident tracker.

liam: ack, I'll take primary at 07:00. If anything spikes escalate to oncall-sre rotation. Note left: APAC egress/edge still a potential weakness — open ticket with CDN team for follow-up.

maya: Thanks team. I pushed notes to incident tracker: https://redwood.internal/incidents/4298765432 (brief + actions). Monitoring thresholds temporarily tightened for 2 hours. :white_check_mark: If anything else arises, page as normal.
